tasks.title: Initialize Electron Forge Project with Vite
tasks.description: Set up the foundational Electron project using Electron Forge with the Vite plugin, configured for React 19 and TypeScript. Establish the monorepo-style structure with main and renderer processes.
tasks.details:
1. Initialize project with `npm init electron-app@latest flusk -- --template=vite-typescript`
2. Configure electron-forge.config.ts for:
   - Frameless window (frame: false, titleBarStyle: 'hidden')
   - Default window size 680x720, min 480x520, max 900x900
   - 12px border radius via CSS
   - Hide from Dock (LSUIElement in Info.plist for macOS)
3. Set up Vite config for React 19 with SWC:
   - Install @vitejs/plugin-react-swc
   - Configure path aliases (@/, @main/, @renderer/)
4. Directory structure:
   ```
   src/
     main/           # Electron main process
       index.ts      # Main entry
       tray.ts       # Menu bar integration
       shortcuts.ts  # Global shortcuts
       ipc.ts        # IPC handlers
     renderer/       # React app
       main.tsx      # React entry
       App.tsx
     preload/        # Preload scripts
       index.ts
   ```
5. Configure TypeScript with strict mode, paths, and Electron types
6. Install core dependencies:
   - electron@^33.0.0 (latest stable)
   - react@^19.0.0, react-dom@^19.0.0
   - typescript@^5.5.0
7. Set up electron-builder or forge packaging config for macOS distribution
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run `npm run start` - app should launch frameless window
2. Verify window dimensions are correct (680x720)
3. Confirm window is resizable within min/max bounds
4. Verify no Dock icon appears (menu bar only)
5. Test hot reload works when editing React components
6. Verify TypeScript compilation succeeds with no errors

tasks.title: Implement SQLite Database with Drizzle ORM
tasks.description: Set up better-sqlite3 with Drizzle ORM in the Electron main process. Define the complete schema for tasks, scratchpad, chat_messages, task_events, ai_journal, and settings tables as specified in the PRD.
tasks.details:
1. Install dependencies:
   - `npm install better-sqlite3 drizzle-orm`
   - `npm install -D drizzle-kit @types/better-sqlite3`
   - Note: better-sqlite3 requires native rebuild for Electron
2. Configure electron-rebuild in package.json scripts
3. Create src/main/db/schema.ts with Drizzle schema:
   ```typescript
   export const tasks = sqliteTable('tasks', {
     id: text('id').primaryKey().$defaultFn(() => crypto.randomUUID()),
     parentId: text('parent_id').references(() => tasks.id),
     title: text('title').notNull(),
     body: text('body'),
     status: text('status', { enum: ['inbox', 'active', 'in_progress', 'done'] }).default('inbox'),
     priority: text('priority', { enum: ['none', 'low', 'medium', 'high'] }).default('none'),
     today: integer('today', { mode: 'boolean' }).default(false),
     client: text('client'),
     dueDate: text('due_date'),
     dueType: text('due_type', { enum: ['hard', 'soft'] }),
     effort: text('effort', { enum: ['unknown', 'tiny', 'small', 'medium', 'deep'] }).default('unknown'),
     invoiceStatus: text('invoice_status', { enum: ['none', 'draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue'] }),
     valueAtRisk: real('value_at_risk'),
     lastClientTouchAt: text('last_client_touch_at'),
     order: integer('order').default(0),
     createdAt: text('created_at').$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
     completedAt: text('completed_at'),
   });
   ```
4. Define all other tables: scratchpad, chat_messages, task_events, ai_journal, settings
5. Create src/main/db/index.ts with database initialization:
   - Store in `~/Library/Application Support/Flusk/flusk.db`
   - Run migrations on app start
6. Create drizzle.config.ts for migrations
7. Set up IPC handlers for database operations in main process

subtasks.title: Define Drizzle schema for tasks table with all 17 fields including enums and self-reference
subtasks.description: Create the complete tasks table schema in Drizzle ORM with all required fields from the PRD: id, parentId, title, body, status, priority, today, client, dueDate, dueType, effort, invoiceStatus, valueAtRisk, lastClientTouchAt, order, createdAt, and completedAt.
subtasks.details:
1. Create src/main/db/schema.ts file
2. Import required Drizzle SQLite types:
   ```typescript
   import { sqliteTable, text, integer, real } from 'drizzle-orm/sqlite-core';
   import { relations } from 'drizzle-orm';
   ```
3. Define the tasks table with all 17 fields:
   ```typescript
   export const tasks = sqliteTable('tasks', {
     id: text('id').primaryKey().$defaultFn(() => crypto.randomUUID()),
     parentId: text('parent_id'),
     title: text('title').notNull(),
     body: text('body'),
     status: text('status', { enum: ['inbox', 'active', 'in_progress', 'done'] }).default('inbox'),
     priority: text('priority', { enum: ['none', 'low', 'medium', 'high'] }).default('none'),
     today: integer('today', { mode: 'boolean' }).default(false),
     client: text('client'),
     dueDate: text('due_date'),
     dueType: text('due_type', { enum: ['hard', 'soft'] }),
     effort: text('effort', { enum: ['unknown', 'tiny', 'small', 'medium', 'deep'] }).default('unknown'),
     invoiceStatus: text('invoice_status', { enum: ['none', 'draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'overdue'] }),
     valueAtRisk: real('value_at_risk'),
     lastClientTouchAt: text('last_client_touch_at'),
     order: integer('order').default(0),
     createdAt: text('created_at').$defaultFn(() => new Date().toISOString()),
     completedAt: text('completed_at'),
   });
   ```
4. Define self-referential relation for subtasks:
   ```typescript
   export const tasksRelations = relations(tasks, ({ one, many }) => ({
     parent: one(tasks, { fields: [tasks.parentId], references: [tasks.id] }),
     subtasks: many(tasks),
   }));
   ```
5. Export TypeScript types for insert/select operations:
   ```typescript
   export type Task = typeof tasks.$inferSelect;
   export type NewTask = typeof tasks.$inferInsert;
   ```

1. TypeScript compilation should pass with no errors on schema file
2. Enum values should be type-checked (e.g., status only accepts 'inbox' | 'active' | 'in_progress' | 'done')
3. Create test insert with minimal fields (just title) - should work with defaults
4. Create test insert with parentId pointing to existing task - should work

subtasks.details:

   - fadeInFromTop: { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: -10 }, visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, exit: { opacity: 0, y: -10 } } with 150ms duration, ease-out

   - Use window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')

5. Export animation constants:
   - DURATION_FAST: 100 (hover states)
